name: QA-1124-EPD-02: An EPD approved after signing (Merchant Call) sends a revised contract with the new EPD
description:
Objective: An EPD approved after signing (Merchant Call) sends a revised contract.
Preconditions: Kesef CRM QA at the configured origin; authorized test account; an existing application in the needed state discovered read-only, or an unsaved intake whose writes are blocked.
Steps:
1. Follow the reproduction steps of QA-1124-EPD-02.
2. Evaluate the encoded checks in `test_epd_approved_after_signing_resends_the_contract`.
3. Record any mismatch.
Expected: 1. An EPD approved after signing (Merchant Call) sends a revised contract.
2. The bug's expected result holds; no unintended record or state residue.
